post.summary: Launches a new workflow of the specified type.
post.description:
If the Wait or Immediate options are specified then the workflow will be launched immediately. Otherwise the workflow will be queued up to be launched in the background.

Workflow Type security will be checked for View permissions unless Unrestricted Edit permissions are granted to the current person.

If entity is provided and supports security, then it will be checked for View permission unless Unrestricted Edit permissions are granted to the current person.

parameters.name: workflowTypeId
parameters.description: The workflow type identifier as either an Id, Guid or IdKey value.

parameters.name: request
parameters.description: The details describing how the workflow should be launched.

200.description: Returned when the request specifies that the workflow should be awaited.

204.description: Returned when the workflow is launched in the background.

Rock.ViewModels.Rest.CheckIn.Configurati.description:
The request parameters to use when requesting the list of valid
check-in configurations.

kioskId.description:
Gets or sets the kiosk identifier to use when filtering
the configuration list.

Rock.ViewModels.Rest.CheckIn.Configurati.description: The response to the request to get all check-in configuration data.

templates.description: Gets or sets the templates that are valid for use with check-in.

areas.description: Gets or sets the areas that are valid for use with check-in.

Rock.ViewModels.CheckIn.ConfigurationTem.description: The summary information about a single check-in configuration template.

id.description:
Gets or sets the identifier of this check-in configuration
template.

name.description: Gets or sets the name of this check-in configuration.

iconCssClass.description: Gets or sets the icon CSS class defined on the check-in configuration.

abilityLevelDetermination.description:
Gets a value that determines how check-in should gather the
ability level of the current individual.

kioskCheckInType.description:
Gets the type of check-in experience to use. Family check-in allows
more than one person in the family to be checked in at a time.

familySearchType.description:
Gets or sets the type of the family search configured for
the configuration.

isAutoSelect.description:
Gets or sets a value indicating whether auto-select mode is enabled
for this template. In auto-select mode all the selected information
is displayed on the person select screen with an optional button to
change those selections.

isCheckoutAtKioskAllowed.description:
Gets or sets a value indicating whether to allow self-checkout on
public kiosks for this configuration. When enabled, if an individual
in the family is already checked in then the kiosk will prompt if
they want to check-in another family member of checkout existing
individuals.

isLocationCountDisplayed.description:
Gets a value indicating whether the current location occupancy
counts should be displayed when selecting a location.

isOverrideAvailable.description:
Gets a value indicating whether an override option is available in
the kiosk supervisor screen. This allows an authorized support
person to bypass check-in requirements.

isPhotoHidden.description:
Gets a value indicating whether individual photos should be hidden
on public kiosks.

isRemoveFromFamilyAtKioskAllowed.description:
Gets a value indicating whether removing people with a "can check-in"
relationship from the family is allowed. This does not allow
full family members to be removed.

isSupervisorEnabled.description:
Gets a value indicating whether the supervisor screen is available
to kiosks after entering a pin number.

isSameOptionUsed.description:
Gets a value indicating whether to attempt to use the same options
from the first service when a person is checking into more than one
service schedule.

maximumPhoneNumberLength.description:
Gets or sets the maximum length of the phone number during
family search.

minimumPhoneNumberLength.description:
Gets or sets the minimum length of the phone number during
family search.

phoneSearchType.description: Gets or sets the type of the phone search used in family search.

Rock.ViewModels.CheckIn.ConfigurationAre.description: The summary information about a single check-in area.

id.description: Gets or sets the identifier of this check-in area.

name.description: Gets or sets the name of this check-in area.

primaryTemplateIds.description:
Gets or sets the configuration template identifiers that are
considered primary for this area. A primary configuration template
is one that this area is a descendant of.

Rock.ViewModels.Rest.CheckIn.KioskStatus.description: The request parameters to use when requesting the current status of a kiosk.

kioskId.description: Gets or sets the kiosk identifier.

areaIds.description:
Gets or sets the area identifiers the kiosk is currently
configured for.

Rock.ViewModels.Rest.CheckIn.KioskStatus.description: The response to the request to get the check-in kiosk status.

status.description: Gets or sets the current status of the kiosk.

Rock.ViewModels.CheckIn.KioskStatusBag.description: Defines the current status of a kiosk configuration.

isCheckInActive.description: Gets or sets a value indicating whether check-in is currently active.

hasOpenLocations.description: Gets or sets a value indicating whether this kiosk has any open locations.

nextStartDateTime.description:
Gets or sets the next start date time today. A value of null
indicates that this kiosk will not open again today.

nextStopDateTime.description: Gets or sets the next stop date time today.

campusCurrentDateTime.description: Gets or sets the campus current date time.

serverCurrentDateTime.description: Gets or sets the server current date time.

locationIds.description:
Gets or sets the location identifiers. A change in one of
these locations should trigger an update of the kiosk status.

scheduleIds.description:
Gets or sets the schedule identifiers. A change in one of
these schedules should trigger an update of the kiosk status.

Rock.ViewModels.Rest.CheckIn.SearchForFa.description:
The options that will be provided to the SearchForFamilies check-in
REST endpoint.

Gets or sets the check-in configuration template identifier.
This identifies the configuration that should be used when
validating the search and compiling results.

kioskId.description: Gets or sets the optional kiosk identifier.

searchTerm.description: Gets or sets the term to search for.

searchType.description: Gets or sets the type of the search to perform.

prioritizeKioskCampus.description:
Gets or sets a value indicating whether to prioritize families
that are part of the same campus as the kiosk. This requires that
the KioskGuid parameter be specified.

The response that will be returned by the SearchForFamilies check-in
REST endpoint.

families.description: Gets or sets the families that matched the search request.

A search result item representing a single family in check-in
family search.

id.description: Gets or sets the identifier of the family Group.

name.description: Gets or sets the name of the family.

campusId.description: Gets or sets the family campus identifier.

members.description: Gets or sets the family members.

Rock.ViewModels.CheckIn.FamilyMemberBag.description:
A single member of a family. A family member may not belong to the actual
family as they may be assocaited via a "can check-in" relationship. This
can be determined by the {Rock.ViewModels.CheckIn.FamilyMemberBag.IsInPrimaryFamily} value.

person.description: Gets or sets the person that represents this family member.

familyId.description: Gets or sets the primary family identifier this person belongs to.

isInPrimaryFamily.description:
Gets or sets a value indicating whether this attendee is in the
primary family matched during the search operation.

roleOrder.description:
Gets or sets the group role order. This can be used to order parents
above children.

Rock.ViewModels.CheckIn.PersonBag.description: A family member that identifies a single individual for check-in.

id.description: Gets or sets the identifier of the Person.

firstName.description: Gets or sets the first name.

nickName.description: Gets or sets the person's nick name.

lastName.description: Gets or sets the last name.

fullName.description: Gets or sets the full name.

birthYear.description: Gets or sets the birth year.

birthMonth.description: Gets or sets the birth month.

birthDay.description: Gets or sets the birth day.

birthDate.description:
Gets or sets the birth date. If this date is used, the time zone
information should be thrown away so that just the raw date is
left. Otherwise the birthdate might shift by one day depending
on the time zone.

gender.description: Gets or sets the person's gender.

agePrecise.description: Gets or sets the precise age as a floating point number.

gradeOffset.description:
Gets or sets the grade offset, this should only be used for sorting
purposes. To display the grade use the GradeFormatted property.

gradeFormatted.description: Gets or sets the grade formatted for display purposes.

abilityLevel.description: Gets or sets the current ability level of the person.

isSpecialNeeds.description:
Determines the value of the person's Is Special Needs attribute
value.

photoUrl.description: Gets or sets the photo URL.

determine which options are available for each family member.

to enable the override mode in kiosk check-in. Opportunity filtering
will not be performed when in this mode.

Gets or sets all possible schedules that are available across all
of the people in this family. If schedule A is available for the
first person and schedule B is available for the second person then
both schedule A and B will be included.

people.description:
Gets or sets the people that can be potentially checked in for
the family.

currentlyCheckedInAttendances.description: Gets or sets the current attendance records that can be checked out.

isPreSelected.description: Gets or sets a value indicating whether this attendee is already selected.

isMultipleSelectionsAvailable.description: Gets or sets a value indicating whether this attendee has multiple selections available.

isInPrimaryFamily.description:

unavailableMessage.description: Gets or sets the message describing why this attendee is not available.

Rock.ViewModels.CheckIn.OpportunityColle.description:
Defines the opportunities available to a single individual during
check-in.

abilityLevels.description: Gets or sets the ability levels available to select from.

areas.description: Gets or sets the areas that are available for check-in.

groups.description: Gets or sets the groups that are available for check-in.

locations.description: Gets or sets the locations that are available for check-in.

schedules.description: Gets or sets the schedules that are available for check-in.

Rock.ViewModels.CheckIn.AbilityLevelOppo.description: Defines a single ability level that can be used during check-in.

isDisabled.description:
Determines if this ability level is unavailable for selection during
a self-serve check-in. This may be overridden when assisted by a
staff member. If every ability level is disabled then the entire
screen should be skipped.

isDeprioritized.description:
Determines if this ability level should be considered of lower
priority than the others. This is used to indicate that the selected
ability level is currently higher than this item and it should be
displayed in a way to make it clear that this wouldn't normally be
selected.

name.description: Gets or sets the display name of this item.

How locations should be selected when a group in this area is
being used for check-in.

Gets or sets the ability level identifier required to
attend this group.

Gets or sets the locations that are valid for this group. These
come as a LocationId and ScheduleId pair. These are in proper order
of location priority.

Gets or sets the details about the check-in session that apply
to all attendance requests.

Rock.ViewModels.CheckIn.AttendanceSessio.description:
Identifies information about an attendance session that is being
requested to be created.

guid.description:
Gets or sets the unique identifier of the check-in session. This is
a unique identifier instead of a regular identifier since it needs
to come from the client.

isPending.description:
Gets or sets a value indicating whether this session should create
pending attendance records that will later be made permanent all
at once.

isCapacityThresholdEnforced.description:
Gets or sets a value indicating whether this session should enforce
location capacity limits on the locations.

familyId.description:
Gets or sets the family identifier that was determined during
the family search operation.

searchMode.description: Gets or sets the mode used when searching for families.

performedByPersonId.description:
Gets or sets the identifier of the person performing the action
for this session.

Rock.ViewModels.CheckIn.AttendanceReques.description:
Identifies a single attendance record that is being requested to be
created with the specified options.

personId.description:
Gets or sets the identifier of the person to create an attendance
record for.

selection.description:
Gets or sets the selection that identify where the person should
be checked in to. Only the Id values are used.

note.description:
Gets or sets the note to put on the attendance record. If an existing
attendance record is updated then this will replace the note value.

The response that will be returned by the SaveAttendance check-in
REST endpoint.

Rock.ViewModels.CheckIn.Labels.ClientLab.description:
Defines the structure of a label that should be printed by the client
instead of the server.

printerAddress.description:
The address of the printer. This should be either an IP address or
an IP address and port number.

data.description: The data to be printed encoded in base-64 format.

Rock.ViewModels.CheckIn.RecordedAttendan.description: Details about a newly recorded attendance record.

attendance.description: Gets or sets the attendance details.

inProgressAchievements.description: Gets or sets the in progress achievements.

previouslyCompletedAchievements.description:
Gets or sets the achievements that were completed before the new
attendance record was created.

justCompletedAchievements.description:
Gets or sets the achievements that were just completed by this
new attendance record.

Rock.ViewModels.CheckIn.AchievementBag.description: Defines the details of an achievement for the check-in process.

id.description: Gets or sets the identifier of the achievement attempt.

achievementTypeId.description: Gets or sets the identifier of the achievement type.

name.description: Gets or sets the name of the achievement type.

progress.description:
Gets or sets the progress with 1.0 being fully achieved.
This value may exceep 1.0 if over-achievement is allowed.

targetCount.description:
Gets or sets the target count of things that must be done for this
achievement to be considered accomplished.

isSuccess.description: Gets or sets a value indicating whether this achievement was successful.

isClosed.description:
Gets or sets a value indicating whether this achievement is closed.
A closed achievement will not be updated further.

startDateTime.description: Gets or sets the start date time.

endDateTime.description: Gets or sets the end date time.

checked out.

Rock.ViewModels.Rest.CheckIn.ProximityCh.description:
Describes the values that are expected to be sent to the ProximityCheckIn
API endpoint.

proximityGuid.description:
The unique identifier of the proximity group. Multiple beacons
will share the same unique identifier. There is usually only one
proximity identifier per organization.

beacons.description:
The set of beacons that were detected when entering or leaving
an area.

isPresent.description:
true if this message indicates that the individual has entered
            the area; otherwise, false.

personalDeviceGuid.description:
The unique identifier of the personal device that is being used
when the area was entered or left.

Rock.ViewModels.Rest.CheckIn.ProximityBe.description:
Describes a single beacon that was detected when entering or leaving
a proximity area.

major.description:
The major identifier value (0 - 65535) of the beacon. This is used
to identify the campus.

minor.description:
The minor identifier value (0 - 65535) of the beacon. This is used
to identify the specific location within the campus.

rssi.description:
The signal strength of the beacon. This is used to determine how
close the individual is to the beacon.

accuracy.description: The accuracy estimate of the signal strength.

Rock.ViewModels.Utility.ListItemBag.description: Identifies a single item that will be displayed through some UI control.

disabled.description: Gets or sets disabled for this item.

mediaAccount.description: The selected Media Account as a ListItemBag

Rock.ViewModels.Rest.Controls.MediaPlaye.description: The options that can be passed to the GetPlayerOptions API action of the MediaPlayer control.

playerOptions.description: The initial set of options to pass to the media player

mediaElementGuid.description: Identifier for the Media Element to play

autoResumeInDays.description:
The number of days back to look for an existing interaction
for the media element. Will be used to find where the user left off
previously and resume from that point.

combinePlayStatisticsInDays.description:
The number of days back to look for an existing
interaction for the media element that should be updated. If one
is not found then a new interaction will be created. Set to
0 to always create a new interaction.

Rock.ViewModels.Rest.Controls.MediaPlaye.description:
The options that can be passed to the GetChildren API action of the AccountPicker control.
            
NOTE: This is copied from Rock/Media/MediaPlayerOptions.cs.
If making any changes to this, be sure to update that as well.

autopause.description:
Gets or sets a value indicating whether to automatically pause
other media players on the page when this player begins playing.

autoplay.description:
Gets or sets a value indicating whether to attempt to automatically
play as soon as it can. This will likely only work if you also
specify the {Rock.ViewModels.Rest.Controls.MediaPlayerOptionsBag.Muted} parameter as most browsers do not
allow auto play with sound.

clickToPlay.description:
Gets or sets a value indicating whether the user will be allowed to
click anywhere on the media player to play or pause the playback.

controls.description:
Gets or sets the user interface controls to display on the player.
This should be a comma delimited list of values taken from MediaPlayerControls.

debug.description:
Gets or sets a value indicating whether debug information should

offset.description:
Gets or sets the number of items to skip before the first item the result set. This
is processed after {Rock.ViewModels.Core.EntitySearchQueryBag.Sort} performs sorting.

limit.description:
Gets or sets the number of items to include in the result set.
This is processed after {Rock.ViewModels.Core.EntitySearchQueryBag.Offset} is processed.

Rock.ViewModels.Rest.Models.Workflows.La.description: Details about how the workflow should be launched.

entityTypeId.description:
The entity type identifier as either an Id, Guid, IdKey, or name
value. This will be used when loading the entity to launch the
workflow with.

entityId.description:
The entity identifier as either an Id, Guid or IdKey value to
launch the workflow with.

isEntityRequired.description:
If true then an error should be returned if the entity
was specified but could not be found.

name.description:
The name to set on the workflow. If not provided then a default
name will be used based on the workflow type name.

attributeValues.description:
The attribute values that will be provided to the workflow. The
key should match the key of a workflow attribute. The value is the
raw database value that it will be set to.

immediate.description:
If true then the workflow will be launched immediately.
Otherwise the workflow is launched in the background and may take
up to one minute to be launched.

wait.description:
If true then the request will not return until the workflow
has launched and completed processing. This will also force
{Rock.ViewModels.Rest.Models.Workflows.LaunchWorkflowOptionsBag.Immediate} to be true.

Rock.ViewModels.Rest.Models.Workflows.La.description: Contains the response data from launching a workflow.

id.description:
The integer identifier of the launched workflow. Will be 0 if the
workflow was not waited or not set to persist.

guid.description:
The unique identifier of the launched workflow. Will be an empty
Guid value if the workflow was not waited or not set to persist.

idKey.description:
The identifier key of the launched workflow. Will be null if the
workflow was not waited or not set to persist.

isActive.description:
If the workflow was waited and did not fully complete while
processing then this value will be true. For example, if the
workflow hit an Entry form it will stop processing but remain
active.

status.description:
The value of the status property for the workflow that was launched.
This will be null if the workflow was not waited.

errors.description: Will contain any errors that occurred while processing the workflow.
